description: Published-topic validator (Go `Validate`, Rust `validate`): 4 segments, each ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$, total length <= 128 bytes, no wildcards, no tense rule. `error` is the full error string (the InvalidTopicError message, which wraps the ErrInvalidTopic sentinel); `ok` true means no error. Violations are reported in order: empty, length, segment count, then segments left to right.
